summary.zh: 定位注册流程的流失步骤，逐字段减少阻碍
summary.en: Find where signups drop off and strip friction field by field

description.zh: 在注册、报名或试用开通流程中找出用户流失的那一步，再逐个字段、逐个步骤拆掉多余摩擦，并给出可验证的改法。适合注册转化偏低，或正在设计新的注册流程时使用。分析脚本需要本地 Python 环境。
description.en: Finds the step where people abandon a signup, registration or trial-start flow, then removes friction field by field with changes you can test. Use it when signup conversion is low or a new flow is being designed. The analyzer needs Python.
